content: Impact of Character Embeddings. First, we investigate the effect of the pretrained character embeddings in our proposed crowdsourcing learning model. The comparison results are shown in Figure 2 , where Random refers to the random initialized character embeddings, and Pretrained refers to the embeddings pretrained on the unlabeled data. According to the results, we find that our model with the pretrained embeddings significantly outperforms that using the random embeddings, demonstrating that the pretrained embeddings successfully provide useful information.
